integrity: All infinite statements are proved symbolically. Finite computation is used only as an independent regression check and not as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the terminal layer b-a=r-1 in the family of weighted projective spaces with r unit weights and two heavier weights. The local quasismoothness test specializes classical weighted-hypersurface machinery; the claimed contribution is the exact divisor classification, count, and summatory asymptotic on this layer.
title: Divisor law and zero density for quasismooth anticanonical hypersurfaces on the first terminal layer
